name: d435i-wrist-d405-match-nominal
description: Experimental D435i wrist pose plus effective post-crop intrinsics. It moves each wrist optical center along the reference camera-to-grasp ray from 116.96 mm to 166.72 mm, then models a centered 584x360 crop resized to 640x360. Replace nominal intrinsics and hand-eye poses with measurements before hardware use.
